description: Skein evaluator for the proton's canonical 11-crossing flavored braid. Computes three independent Skein values: (1) V(𝓑₃, t) closed-form Jones polynomial at t = q_0² / q_0 / -q_0⁻¹ conventions; (2) |tr_M(β_p, q_0)| from markov_peel.tr_M_atomic (existing canonical infrastructure); (3) cross-check vs the canonical Layer-1 |tr_M| atlas value 1.0653062286. Closes the S(p) ≈ 0 assumed-zero gap in conj:borromean-baryon-mass-formula.

jones_borromean_at_q0.note: Kauffman 1987 standard t-convention. The Hecke/Jones original substitution is t = q²; the Kauffman bracket uses t = -A⁻², equivalent to t = -q⁻¹ in our convention. The proton's canonical closure is topologically 𝓑₃, so its standalone Jones polynomial equals V(𝓑₃) at any t.

S(p) = 0 hypothesis.verdict: Family A m_avg layer: ~29 000 ppm above CODATA m_p — this gap is in λ_scale, NOT in S(p).  S(p) ≈ 0 remains the production assumption (flavor split supplies the m_n − m_p split downstream).

S(p) = |tr_M(β_p, q_0)| hypothesis.verdict: Adds |tr_M(β_p)| ≈ 1.07 to the tower; m_p_pred shifts by ~580 ppm.  Negligible compared to the 29 000 ppm m_avg gap.  Does not discriminate between S(p) hypotheses at this layer.

S(p) = V(𝓑₃, q²) hypothesis.verdict: Adds V(𝓑₃, q²) ≈ 4.04 to the tower; ~2 200 ppm shift.  Still small vs the 29 000 ppm Family A gap — does not discriminate.

skein_hypothesis_panel.interpretation: Under the PROVED Family A λ_scale (replacing the prior fitted 2.4599527869, removed 2026-05-22), the bare Vol·λ_A/ℏ_q² tower lands m_p_pred ≈ 966 MeV — about 2.9 % above CODATA.  All three S(p) hypotheses produce shifts of <0.3 % vs that gap, so the m_avg residual is dominated by the λ_scale layer, NOT by S(p).  S(p) ≈ 0 remains the production assumption; the proton-neutron split is supplied separately by the substrate flavor-split formula (`prop:flavor-split-substrate`, PR #690 / #942).  The original 'S(p) = 0 forced by 1 ppb closure' argument was an artifact of the CAL-4 fitted λ_p; under Family A the S(p) discriminator becomes structural rather than 1-ppb-numerical.
